title: DynamicTrader
description: A comprehensive trading ecosystem for your server, combining advanced trading mechanics and economy systems.
body:
🤖 Smart Trader with Dynamic Pricing
Automatic price regulation based on supply and demand
Auction influence - prices adjust according to market situation
Daily rotation of items from extensive catalog
Intuitive interface with price change visualization

**/trader**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/871584156c1c0f08e074a1ee0abc67bb278c62da.png)

🏆 Multi-Functional Auction
Dual currency - support for two independent currency systems
Smart categories - advanced item categorization system
Virtual warehouse - secure storage for trading items
Flexible bidding - various auction types and trading conditions

**/auc**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daf916c1f45e8b3a9bcdeca97cb0e595035df048_0.webp)

💼 Complete Economic System
Market integration - trader and auction influence each other
Real-time statistics - tracking economic indicators
Economy balancing - automatic maintenance of healthy economy
Multi-currency operations - flexible financial instruments

bl.stats.own        # View own statistics
bl.stats.others     # View others statistics
